limits: headless; no Orca speech or physical desktop certification
Native controls and established Shell CSS/tokens reused
Reflow/font-200 and keyboard are separately covered by test_layout_presets

mediaExplanation.native: All three real chrome media queries become true after restart with ui.useAccessibilityTheme, ui.prefersReducedMotion and ui.prefersReducedTransparency set.
mediaExplanation.content: Reduced transparency remains false in the Shell document; Gecko159 Gecko_MediaFeatures_PrefersReducedTransparency returns false when its RFP target applies. No protection is disabled to alter this result. Shell surfaces remain opaque.

visualReview: Wide light/dark presets preserve native navigation and security controls above the Settings form. Choices and descriptions stay aligned; Focus uses the real compact native tab list. Narrow 320px/200% flows vertically with readable wrapping and scrolling; no section overflow was measured. Native glyphs, typography and existing Shell tokens are retained.
